discussion.body:
Separate log: Archon Velith (Bengenia / Mist). Face one of three. Living appearance hides undeath.
Copied living plates, not reuploaded. New undead study generated from the accepted living build (same tall cold Archon, long pale hair, sleeveless tunic, no veil-crown). Undead tells: milky mist eyes, gray mouth, porcelain cracks at collarbones, arms, and knees. Preserved smotherer, not a rotting corpse, not Nyxara.
Locals: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-002-velith-build-study.jpg, FEAT-002-velith-undead-study.jpg. Existing clothed plate stays. No status change. HEAD not moved.
